blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Thursday confirmed that it has served subpoenas on two witnesses named by Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team, including a Bureau of Customs (BOC) official and a former co-owner of Cale88 Foods Corp., ahead of next week’s hearings. Senate impeachment court spokesperson Regie Tongol said Presiding Officer Francis Escudero signed the subpoenas on Nov. 25, directing BOC Deputy Commissioner Agaton Teodoro O. Uvero and Lourdes Tingson-Lebosada to appear before the court and submit documents related to Cale88. Cale88, a banana chip manufacturing company formerly co-owned by Duterte’s husband Manases Carpio, has figured in […]...
